name: Acoustic singer-songwriter for a wedding cocktail hour: Tejas Singh, Thirty Days
seoTitle: Tejas Singh at a wedding cocktail hour: Thirty Days
description: Tejas Singh sings Thirty Days with his acoustic guitar at a wedding cocktail hour, and he plays soft enough that guests can keep talking.
more: As a duo, Tejas is a singer-guitarist plus bass, and that size can work well for cocktails and dinner. When it's time to dance, the rest of the band can join him. The duo is a nice fit for a client dinner or a member event, too, and if you only need an hour, we can do that.
